messages:
From: sec-ops@snowpeak.com
To: diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial CAIQ ask — compact crosswalk and evidence demo

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for taking a look at our CAIQ. To move the assessment forward we need a compact crosswalk (top-level CAIQ control -> Redwood control owner + artifact pointer) and a short live walkthrough of the evidence for high-risk controls (encryption, key mgmt, dataflow tracing).

Deliverables we're expecting: a one-sheet crosswalk we can attach to our audit, an evidence index (PDF or Drive), and a 30–45 minute live session with your security or engineering lead to walk us through the artifacts.

Can you confirm owners, attach a compact crosswalk, and propose 2–3 slots for the walkthrough next week?

Appreciate it,
Cole (SnowPeak Security)
sec-ops@snowpeak.com

Cole — thanks for the clear ask. Attaching a compact crosswalk (see 20270615-CAIQ-compact-crosswalk-v1.xlsx) and a short evidence index PDF. High-level notes:

- Owners:
  - Key management / HSM: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com)
  - Dataflow / ingress-egress logs: Priyom Das (priyom_das@redwoodinference.com)
  - Runtime encryption & secrets: Kimberly Park (kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com)

- Evidence format: we point to log excerpts, config screenshots, and signed artifact bundles in the Drive link below. We intentionally keep the crosswalk compact (control -> short control statement -> owner -> primary artifact).

Proposed walkthrough slots (PDT):
  - Wed 2027-06-16 14:00–14:45
  - Thu 2027-06-17 09:00–09:45
  - Thu 2027-06-17 15:00–15:45

If none work, propose two alternate windows. For the live session we'll have the control owner share screen, show the artifact, and leave 10 minutes for Q&A.

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
